name: hud_sensor_map_node_draw_on_tracker
description: HudSensorMapNode::DrawOnTracker updates blink color state, projects and clips the map path against tracker rectangles, draws visible immediate line segments, and draws the selected-point diamond marker.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because the large stack loop renders previous projected-point accesses as negative zVec3 offsets and the blink-timer x87 store has flag-generation tags at 0x415d56.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation at 0x415d30 shows blink-timer decrement and color-pair swap, ProjectWorldPointsToOverlay, outer HudLineClip bounds, inner HudRectI::ClipOrSplitSegment, immediate line draws, selected-point DrawDiamondMarker, and optional DrawProjectedPath dispatch.

Direct authored callees ProjectWorldPointsToOverlay, HudLineClip::SetCurrentBoundsFromRectI, HudLineClip::ClipSegmentToCurrentBounds, HudRectI::ClipOrSplitSegment, zRndr_DrawImmediateLine, HudSensorTracker::DrawDiamondMarker, and HudSensorMapNode::DrawProjectedPath are dependency-ready and functional-equivalent; __alloca_probe and _ftol are provider-backed.

The native HUD smoke verifies blink color swapping, closed-loop projected map path drawing through the immediate-line callback, low-word line color, selected-point diamond dispatch through the clipped-line callback, high-word marker color, and active frame buffer and tracker clip pointer forwarding.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x415d30 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
